== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Enforcer]] techniques are a fundamental category of combat abilities used by practitioners to enhance their physical capabilities or manipulate [[madra]]. These techniques are categorized into several distinct types, including full-body techniques, which can cover a user in translucent or glowing [[madra]] to provide armor, increased speed, explosive strength, or specialized effects like reinforcing a skeleton for stability. Some techniques are more specialized, such as spiritual [[Enforcer]] techniques used for internal [[madra]] manipulation or weapon-based techniques that enhance the properties of a blade or shield. [[Enforcer]] attack techniques are individual strikes that augment a single motion with significant power. While these attacks can be more potent than full-body applications, they are often described as being clumsier and leaving the user vulnerable to retaliation. These attacks can sometimes overlap with [[Striker techniques]], which are characterized by having a clear input and output. Mastery of these abilities is achieved through repetitive practice under various conditions to improve efficiency. While highly effective for boosting movement and combat prowess, the use of these techniques is dependent on a user's available [[madra]] and can be disrupted by certain spiritual tools or the exhaustion of energy reserves.}}
